name: SWEEP-S13v1 Stronger minds
_design: Lead's model probe, the one deliberate exception to Haiku: the S2v2 world and pure instruction exactly (no tip), with every agent on Sonnet 5 (claude-cli-sonnet, prompted JSON). Question: is the missing skill writing a Haiku limit or a world-design limit? 40 rounds to cap cost (~$0.02 per Sonnet decision).
